author: Okkerka
name: RandomText
short: Configurable random chat posts with Components V2 settings.
description: Random facts, jokes, shower thoughts and brainrot with channel restrictions, category controls, saved frequency ranges, safe previews and hybrid commands.
install_msg: Open [p]randomtext to configure automatic posts. Slash equivalents are available after enabling RandomText in Red's slash settings. Existing settings are preserved. Requires a Components V2-capable Red installation; see README.
end_user_data_statement: Stores server settings, selected channel IDs and a server-wide message counter. Does not persist message contents or user IDs. A bounded, temporary cache contains fetched or generated public content.
